info.title: MP3 frame counter API
info.description: Upload raw MPEG-1 Layer III audio to count complete physical frames. Requests stay in memory and are limited to 20 MiB; at most two uploads are admitted concurrently.

post.description: Raw binary file, never multipart or JSON. Media type comparison is case-insensitive and parameters are tolerated. Content-Encoding is absent or a single case-insensitive identity token. Enforce the inclusive 20971520-byte limit against actual bytes even without Content-Length. A trustworthy larger Content-Length may reject before admission. Path then method then media/encoding precede body collection, empty validation and parser. Count complete physical frames including complete Xing/Info/VBRI-bearing frames; never trust metadata frame totals. The preserved r3 supported MPEG/tag subset applies. Unknown paths return 404; HEAD has 405 headers and no body. Invalid wire framing may be rejected before API JSON handling.

x-transport-requirements.description: Expect 100-continue is sent only after route/header validation and slot admission. Busy uploads receive readable 503 plus Retry-After before any body; unsupported expectations receive 417. Deadlines receive readable 408 and release capacity. Allocation, retention, exact configuration and graceful drain require independent source/resource/operational review. OpenAPI cannot prove timing, byte enforcement, connection cleanup or memory bounds.
